definitions.explanation: A flat board used as a surface for cutting food in the kitchen.

examples.english: Cut meat on the cutting board.

examples.japanese: まな{板|いた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漂白剤|ひょうはくざい}→漂白剤：07035_hyouhakuzai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Disinfect the cutting board with bleach.
A carp on the cutting board. (Idiom: Someone who is at the mercy of others)
examples.notes: Describes helpless resignation to one's fate

notes:
Also written as {俎板|まないた} or {俎|まないた} (rare).

Materials:
- ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧ (wooden) - traditional, gentle on knives
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (plastic) - easy to clean, affordable
- ⟦ゴム→ゴム：00073_gomu⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (rubber) - quiet, knife-friendly
- ⟦{抗菌|こうきん}→抗菌：21567_koukin⟧⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧ (antibacterial type)

Many Japanese kitchens have separate boards for:
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧/⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (meat/fish)
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (vegetables)

The idiom 「まな{板|いた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鯉|こい}→鯉：02209_koi⟧」 describes accepting one's fate helplessly, like a fish waiting to be prepared.
